messages:
Lisa (Support): heads-up — customer reported big latency spike and 401s. They say console shows region=eu-west-1 but our request logs show serving region us-east-1. Ticket #CS-5421.
Omar - Infra: can you paste the sample request/response headers and a log line? Might be a routing fallback.
Lisa (Support): pasted sample from customer below. They used the hosted API, region selector = eu-west-1 in console.
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.run
Authorization: Bearer sk-cus-xxx
x-client-region: eu-west-1
Content-Type: application/json
```
Response headers from their capture:
```
x-serving-region: us-east-1
x-request-id: r-12345
status: 200 (but 401s intermittently)
latency-ms: 420
```
Log extract (our edge):
```
[2026-10-28T12:04:01Z] r-12345 routed -> pop-us-east-1 (fallback cap reached eu-west-1)
[2026-10-28T12:04:01Z] auth: token validated via KMS-cluster-us-east-1, ttl=0.3s
[2026-10-28T12:04:01Z] kv-cache: miss
```
Lisa (Support): customer says billing shows requests in eu-west-1 which is what they expect, but metrics and logs show us-east-1. They're worried about data residency and unexpected cross-region charges.
MK (SRE): quick thought — there was a capacity pressure event in eu-west-1 at 12:03 UTC and the routing policy did region-failover to nearest available which was us-east-1. Console badges are driven from metadata service that was stale for ~5m due to cache invalidation bug. So UI still claimed eu-west-1 while runtime routed to us-east-1.
sarah.prod: customers hit auth errors — could KMS key policies cause intermittent 401 when the request lands in a different region?
Omar - Infra: yes: some customers use region-scoped KMS keys. If token exchange assumes eu-west KMS endpoint but actual signing happens in us-east, we can see auth TTL skew causing 401s. Need to confirm which flow.
Lisa (Support): I reproduced with a small script from their account (using their repro token) and saw ~20% 401s during the window. Repro steps I used posted below.
```
# repro
for i in 1..30:
  curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-repro-xxx" -H "x-client-region: eu-west-1" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Observed 401s at iterations 6, 7, 12 then 200s.
raj.sales: customer is annoyed. Asking for immediate mitigation — can we pin their account to eu-west until fix?
MK (SRE): short-term mitigation: add explicit routing hint that honors `x-client-region` for that account (force-route). I'll open a change with a 10min rollout window. It will bypass the fallback for that account only.
Omar - Infra: I'll also push a hotfix to the metadata cache invalidation so console shows actual serving pop on the admin pane. Patch id: infra/route-fix-112. infra-bot: deploy started.
infra-bot: deploy infra/route-fix-112 started by Omar - Infra at 2026-10-28T12:25:00Z.
Lisa (Support): notified customer of temporary pin and asked for log captures to confirm fix. They asked for confirmation on billing —
sarah.prod: Finance: cross-region billing is applied based on serving region. For remediation, if they were routed to us-east we need to offer a credit. Please tag Billing and Legal for contract notes.
MK (SRE): action items: (1) force-route account CS-5421 until capacity normalizes (Omar), (2) metadata-cache hotfix (Omar, deployed), (3) KMS region routing audit to avoid auth TTL skews (MK), (4) billing credit proposal (finance) and (5) postmortem within 72h (sarah.prod).
Lisa (Support): confirming force-route is in place, customer sees 200s and X-serving-region now eu-west-1. Still collecting traces to verify no residual auth 401s.
Omar - Infra: note — root cause summary for postmortem: capacity-based region failover + metadata cache stale caused console/metrics mismatch. Will include timeline and mitigation in postmortem.
Lisa (Support): customer accepted temporary fix and asked for permanent guarantee. I told them we'll follow up with SLA addendum + postmortem.
MK (SRE): assigning myself to KMS-routing audit, will share checklist by EOD.
raj.sales: adding note for account team: follow up on credit + contract adjustments.
Lisa (Support): closing the escalation in the ticket once billing and postmortem items are tracked. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Omar - Infra: reopening monitoring rule to alert on "console-serving-pop-mismatch" — will tune sensitivity.
infra-bot: monitor alert created (console-serving-pop-mismatch) by Omar - Infra
Lisa (Support): marking thread resolved for now; will attach postmortem link when available.
